Architecture & Smart Living · House concept

Proposed house concept

TRIXX Hillside Retreat

A site-responsive residence concept that explores stepped levels, terraces and carefully positioned glazing for sloping or view-oriented land.

Enquire about TRIXX Hillside Retreat →

The need

Why this idea matters.

A standard flat-site layout may not respond well to a sloping plot, drainage, views or changes in ground level.

Who it is for

Designed for a conversation with

Buyers considering a sloping or elevated plot who want architecture shaped around the land and its views.

How it could work

A clear path from interest to review.

  1. 01

    Understand the plot through topographic and geotechnical studies.

  2. 02

    Explore stepped spaces, terraces and protected outdoor areas.

  3. 03

    Develop structure, drainage and access with qualified professionals.

Proposed features

What the concept explores.

  • Architecture tailored to site topography
  • Terraces and outdoor viewing areas
  • Stone and timber material direction
  • Glazing planned for views and solar control
  • Site-specific drainage and landscape planning

Potential benefits

What it could make easier.

  • Works with the land instead of assuming a flat site
  • Can frame views while creating sheltered outdoor spaces
  • Surfaces engineering and drainage needs early in the process

Specifications & safeguards

Details remain subject to review.

Pricing, dimensions, technical specifications, availability and timelines are not confirmed. Device compatibility, integrations, data handling, security and professional requirements must be reviewed for the specific project before any capability is promised.
